items.title: Pharma Stocks Have Rallied. 2 Stocks to Avoid—and 2 to Buy.
items.summary: The  exchange-traded fund, home to some large pharma companies and many smaller biotechs, has risen over 6% this week.  The main catalyst was  Moderna  and  Merck  announcement of  successful trial data for a melanoma vaccine that reduces the risk patients will experience recurrence.  “The read-through [from Merck and Moderna] to the others is probably indicative of a broader tailwind of pharma taking some strong actions to improve their long-term growth profiles,” says Cantor Fitzgerald analyst Carter Gould.
